Path traversal via percent-encoded dot segments in fast-uri parser. Reachable transitively via eslint > @eslint/eslintrc > ajv > fast-uri and via aws-cdk-lib's bundled JSON Schema validator. aws-cdk-lib is invoked only at build/synth/deploy time — its ajv usage validates CloudFormation/CDK schemas authored by the developer, not attacker-controlled URIs. No runtime/production code path passes attacker-controlled URIs through ajv schema validation that relies on fast-uri parsing.

CPU denial of service from quadratic rewrite scanning of malicious {a},b}-shaped patterns. Checked 2026-10-02: the only affected installed occurrence is aws-cdk-lib 2.272.0 bundled node_modules/aws-cdk-lib/node_modules/brace-expansion 5.0.9. Available CDK update fixes GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895; compatible nonbundled leaf overrides install 1.1.21/2.1.7/5.0.12, but npm retains the bundled 5.0.9. Its three CDK callers consume trusted CLI bundling context, developer-authored asset exclusions, or unused developer-authored construct selectors; filenames are match subjects, not patterns. No application request/event supplies a pattern. Actual pipeline assets (three directories/four JS files) and both optional observability handlers exclude CDK/minimatch/brace-expansion. Scope is this installed occurrence, not general CDK safety. Owner CodySwannGT; expires 2026-10-16T23:59:59Z; tracking https://github.com/CodySwannGT/cdkstarter/issues/39. Reassess on dependency, glob/context, asset or trust-boundary changes; remove when CDK bundles a compatible patch. Details: docs/security/cdk-bundled-advisories.md.
